steps.en: Outstanding notices at the third reminder stage are collected for today's batch
steps.id: Notice outstanding di stage reminder ketiga dikumpulkan untuk batch hari ini

steps.en: The same individual owner across notices is recognised
steps.id: Pemilik individu yang sama di beberapa notice dikenali
steps.why_en: The same individual owner can still get several messages when due dates differ.
steps.why_id: Pemilik individu yang sama masih bisa dapat beberapa pesan bila due date berbeda.

steps.en: Only individuals who may be notified get an SMS
steps.id: Hanya individu yang boleh dinotifikasi yang dapat SMS

steps.en: The SMS lists all outstanding notices of the recipient
steps.id: SMS memuat semua notice outstanding milik penerima

steps.en: The SMS text refers to the third letter
steps.id: Teks SMS merujuk ke surat ketiga
steps.why_en: Only the template name follows the stage; the wording sits in the database.
steps.why_id: Hanya nama template yang mengikuti stage; isi kalimat ada di database.

steps.en: The SMS reminder is sent to the owner
steps.why_en: Production has the scheduled job and SMS sending both switched off.
steps.why_id: Production mematikan job terjadwal dan pengiriman SMS.
